compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

## What
Wire prior-defense loading for story/* CI runs:

1. In ci-llm-review-runner.sh: pass DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH env var through to the Python runner

2. In plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py:
   - Read PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH env var; if set and file exists, load the JSON as prior_defenses list
   - Apply via existing _apply_defense_memory(findings, prior_defenses) mechanism
   - This is analogous to the existing _fetch_pr_defenses path but reads from a local file instead of gh pr view

3. In .github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml:
   - After download-artifact step, add env var: DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH: /tmp/prior-review/findings.json
   - Use ${{ hashFiles('/tmp/prior-review/findings.json') != '' }} or a shell check to only set when file exists

## Tests pass GREEN after this implementation.
